subject.why: The pineapple is clearly recognisable with its golden body, green crown, and the requested cocktail umbrella charming detail.

category.why: It rests on a plain, solid surface viewed from slightly above, set against a smooth gradient wall from the same warm coral colour family.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, frame, watermark, or characters present.

framing.why: The pineapple is centrally placed with generous margins around all sides.

colour.why: The palette is saturated, warm, and juicy, providing strong separation between the yellow/green pineapple and the coral background.

detail.why: The segments are simplified into smooth, chunky cushions with no realistic micro-textures, scratches, or stray props.

style.why: Features clean 3D volumes, a soft satin sheen, and no harsh outlines, matching the reference game art perfectly.
